description: An infinite cardinal k is regular exactly when any family of fewer than k subsets, each of size below k, has union of size below k.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.Cofinality.regular_iff_small_unions.{u} (k : Cardinal.{u}) (hk : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ k) :
  k.IsRegular ↔
    ∀ (ι α : Type u) (A : ι → Set α),
      Cardinal.mk ι < k → (∀ (i : ι), Cardinal.mk ↑(A i) < k) → Cardinal.mk ↑(⋃ i, A i) < k
